summary.name: Coldplay Affair AI
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns 1–2 adult face photos into a ~10-second, 9:16 stadium kiss-cam style video, sold as pay-per-video credit packs starting at $8.88.
use_cases: Making a joke kiss-cam clip of two consenting adult friends
Creating a vertical stadium-style meme video for social media
Turning a duo photo into a short concert jumbotron gag
Producing a ~10s AI video without editing software
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser tool that takes one or two clear adult face photos (two separate photos or one duo shot) and generates a roughly 10-second 9:16 vertical clip in a stadium kiss-cam format, following a hug, shock, and hide/duck sequence. Output is crowd sound only, with no band music and no manual editing timeline. Pricing is per video via credit packs: Single $8.88 (500 credits, one 720p), Popular $16.99 (1500 credits), and Creator $29.90 (5000 credits); 480p costs 375 credits and failed renders return credits. Payment is one-time via Stripe checkout with no account or subscription. The page states it is an independent fan tool not affiliated with Coldplay, any band, or any sports league, and is restricted to adults who agreed to the joke.
